WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
pair_shares AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    tradekind,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share
  FROM pair_counts
),
scored_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    tradekind,
    record_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share
  FROM pair_shares
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_share
FROM scored_pairs
WHERE share > avg_share
GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: Shares and their trader-type average are computed over all matched transaction–trader-type pairs before filtering; the final averages include only pairs whose share is strictly above that average.
